deals.title: Unbezahlte Werbung donmono_wien What makes it special?
deals.description: One of the most unique restaurants in Vienna, Austria!! If you love steaming bowls of ramen, delicious bao buns and Japanese food that looks just as good as it tastes, DONMONO deserves a spot on your Vienna food list. 🤍 unpaid ad!! Unbezahlte Werbung donmono_wien What makes it special? The mix of Japanese comfort food, flavour-packed broths, colourful toppings and a menu that goes beyond just ramen. Plus, the casual, modern setting makes it a great stop for lunch, a relaxed dinner or your next foodie date. 🍜 What to order & prices: 🥟 Japanese Gyoza (6 pieces) — check the current menu 🍞 Bao Buns with chicken or beef — €5.90 each 🍗 Japanese Chicken Karaage — €6.90 🍜 Tonkotsu or Spicy Tantan Ramen — €16.90 🍛 Chicken Katsu Curry — €14.90 🍚 Bulgogi Don — €13.90 💸 Price range: Around €15–25 per person for a main and possibly a side, depending on what you order. 📍 DONMONO, Vienna — available at Donauzentrum and Millennium City. Save this spot for your next ramen craving & follow janinascheurer for more food spots, hidden gems and places worth visiting! 🫶🏻 Who would you take here? Tag your foodie date below! 👇 #ViennaFood #ViennaRestaurants #ViennaFoodGuide #Donmono RamenLovers
